mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, we have overcast skies and 58 degrees out near the Military Ridge State Trail. The ISS will pass overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

In city news, the Public Works department reminds residents to avoid pouring fats, oils, and grease down the drain to prevent sewer backups. Additionally, the city has officially adopted the 2027 budget.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, or pizza at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, look forward to trivia nights at both The Bogey Factory and Hop Haus Brewing.
On November 9, a 61-year-old man was arrested for his third O W I after being observed driving in an unsafe manner on USH 18 151.
The Culver's flavor of the day is OREO Cookie Cheesecake and the store is currently open until 10 PM, so head over and grab a scoop.
